title: A reader's GitHub sign-in
description: What the Worker knows of one browser's sign-in, which is only what its two sealed cookies hold: explorer_oauth while a sign-in is under way (Path=/auth, 10 minutes) and explorer_session once it has finished (7 days). The Worker keeps no state of its own. The two cookies are independent, so a reader who is signed in and starts again (to include private repositories) stays signed in until the callback replaces the session.

states.description: No explorer_session cookie that unseals under SESSION_SECRET and has not expired. /auth/me answers user: null and /api/github/* answers 401.
An explorer_oauth cookie holds the state, the PKCE verifier, the return path and an expiry 10 minutes ahead; the reader is at GitHub.
explorer_session holds the GitHub token, the login, the avatar address and an expiry 7 days ahead. /auth/me names the reader and /api/github/* reads GitHub with their token.

transitions.guard: one of GITHUB_CLIENT_ID, GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET or SESSION_SECRET is missing
transitions.action: 503: sign-in with GitHub is not set up on this server
seals a random state and PKCE verifier with the return path, and redirects to GitHub's authorize page with the S256 challenge; scope repo only with private=1
as from signed-out; the session cookie is left as it is

transitions.guard: the state matches the sealed one within its 10 minutes, GitHub gives an access token for the code and verifier, and GET /user names an account
transitions.action: seals the session, clears explorer_oauth and redirects to the return path

transitions.guard: no session from before, and the pending cookie is missing, expired or holds another state, or GitHub gives no token or no account
no session from before, and the state matches
transitions.action: clears explorer_oauth and redirects to the return path with signin=denied

transitions.trigger: GET /auth/github/callback that fails or has no code
transitions.guard: a session from before is still valid
transitions.action: as for a failed callback; the earlier session stays
the browser drops explorer_oauth (Max-Age 600), and callback would refuse it after its expiry anyway

transitions.guard: the Origin header is the app's own origin
transitions.action: clears explorer_session; the token is not revoked at GitHub

transitions.trigger: GitHub answers 401 to a read through /api/github/*
transitions.action: passes the 401 on and clears explorer_session

transitions.trigger: the session's 7 days run out, or SESSION_SECRET changes
transitions.action: session() no longer accepts the cookie
